title: Foundation Detailing and Documentation
purpose: Transform validated foundation objects, calculations and checks into traceable technical documentation.
scope: SVG drawings, reinforcement schedule, quantities, technical reports, QA evidence and release packaging.

requirements.title: Chain consumption
requirements.statement: ECP-000001D shall consume outputs from ECP-000001A, ECP-000001B and ECP-000001C.
requirements.rationale: Maintain a real vertical engineering workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Foundation drawings
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a foundation plan and section as vector drawings.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reinforcement schedule
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a traceable reinforcement bar schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Quantities
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate concrete, formwork, excavation and reinforcement quantities.
requirements.rationale: Enable downstream delivery and estimating consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Technical package
requirements.statement: The system shall generate JSON, CSV, Markdown and release artifacts with checksum evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Regulatory controls
requirements.statement: The system shall preserve legal status and require professional review for construction use.
requirements.rationale: Prevent reference equations from being misrepresented as approved design documents.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
